title: Pulling Before You Push
objective: Pull a teammate's change, commit on top of it, push, and print the history.
hint: Set up the shared copy and the clone, and have the clone push Add teammate note. Back in the original: git pull -q --ff-only origin main, then Add-Content My note, git add, git commit -q -m "Add my note", git push -q, and Write-Output (git log --format=%s).
